patient_identity.statement: Family6 Patient8 is the 13-month-old male; prenatal ventriculomegaly and horseshoe kidney at22weeks match packet age/sex/onset.

genotype.statement: Patient8 carries hemizygous ZRSR2 NM_005089.4:c.1211_1212del,NP_005080.1:p.(Gly404GlufsTer23);Table1 gives NC_000023.11:g.15823004_15823005del.
limitations: Family6 supplement writes transcript.3;mainTable1 uses.4.

segregation.statement: Variant is maternally inherited; family6 mother is heterozygous. Affected maternal uncle is not genotyped and was excluded; grandmother unavailable.

phase.statement: Phase not applicable:single hemizygous X-linked allele; no compound-heterozygous phase claim.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors attribute a novel X-linked recessive OFD syndrome to terminal-exon ZRSR2 variants. Patient8 allele supported by clinical/segregation correspondence; functional studies tested patient1 with the other frameshift. Formal OMIM301132/XXI naming and an independently applied ACMG classification are not established here.
limitations: Source correspondence only; not clinical validation or a treatment inference.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Every packet phenotype compared with Table1 and Family6 narrative. Most asserted exclusions are not explicitly examined; several positive HPO terms add specificity. Packet also omits documented macrocrania and groove under lower lip.
limitations: Every packet phenotype compared with Table1 and Family6 narrative. Most asserted exclusions are not explicitly examined; several positive HPO terms add specificity. Packet also omits documented macrocrania and groove under lower lip.

limitations: Do not infer contradiction solely from shifted representation in a repeat.
